HELM row 10 reverses mean/median ordering from 9/12 at full cap to 23/12 at half cap. Open LLM row 1609 reverses from 2/3 to 4/3. These are instance counterexamples, not population rates.
All eight original targets per family are reachable under all rules at full cap. At half cap HELM reachability is 5/5/4 and Open LLM is 7/6/3 for mean/median/Borda.
Every original reference interval closes, all finite selected cardinalities match reference minima, and selected subsets repeat identically across three seeds.
Matched greedy equals the finite minimum for original mean and Borda decisions. HELM row28 median at half cap has optimum21 versus greedy52. No component attribution follows.

Permutation, constant and zero-update controls each have 48 validated decisions per family and seed with no case failure; one first-seed replay is recorded as successful and the remaining replay payloads are absent.

Mean sorted gains, odd-median threshold counting, even-median endpoint counting and rival-aware Borda integer gap constraints describe the inspectable supplied selected source; its tree-digest scope is not equated to the final manifest. Borda search has 20000-node limit, 0.9 work allowance and verified incumbent fallback. Exhaustive scalar verification is used when d<=6.

Independent references use exhaustive six-task subsets, exact scalar HELM checks, and time-limited SciPy binary Borda optimization; random and greedy are matched score-space selection policies, not training algorithms.
Development selection had three scored configurations, zero unscored configurations, and zero aggregate difference from the original baseline; no matched final original-baseline delta is available.
The independent frozen final assessment is completed and qualified; this does not establish generalization, novelty or superiority.
No ablation supports internal component superiority; training-response calibration, strict-margin sensitivity and composition resampling are unavailable. Task budgets are not observed training cost.
